entries.title: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and the power which You have over Your creation, and keep me alive...
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and the power which You have over Your creation, and keep me alive for as long as it is in my best interest to be alive and grant me death when it is best for me. Grant me theability to fear You both in secret and in public and to speak with truth and sincerity in moments of joy and anger. I also ask for moderation in spending, both in poverty and in prosperity. And I ask for Your favours which never end. I ask You to cool my eyes with such favours that will never end. and I ask You to make me submit happily to Your decrees, a comfortable life after death, the delight of seeing Your blessed countenance and the deep desire to meet You. I seek Your protection from disastrous calamities and fitnahs (tests and trials) which cause me to go astray. O Allah, beautify me with the beauty of Imaan, guide us and make us guides for others as well (to the right path). later and whether I know of it or not. I seek Your protection from all evil whether it comes sooner or later and whether I know of it or not. O Allah, I beg of You to grant me Jannah and all such words and deeds which will lead me to it. and And I seek Your protection from the Fire of Hell and all such words and deeds which will lead me to it. I beg of You that Your decree be favourable to me and I beg You that whatever decision You have taken concerning me, let the ultimate end be favourable.

entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I beg of You through Your Messenger, Muhammad Your friend Ibraaheem (alayhis salaam), Musa (alayhis salaam) who had the privilege of speaking to you privately, Isa (alayhis salaam), Your Rooh (spirit) and Your Word; the book (alayhis salaam) and the Holy Qur-aan of Nabi Muhammad ﷺ and from every revelation which You sent (from time to time), from every decision You have passed and by virtue of every such person whose request you have granted, or every poor person whom You have enriched, or every rich person whom You have reduced to poverty, or every misguided person whom You have guided. I beg of You through Your name which You revealed to Musa (alayhis salaam), and I beg of you, Your name which You placed on the earth, so it became steady, which You placed on the heavens and they became stationary, which You placed on the mountains and they became firmly grounded. I beg of You through Your name whereby Your Throne (Arsh) is stable, and through Your pure and clean name which is revealed in Your Book and through Your name which You placed on the day and it brightened, and on the night so it became dark, and through Your greatness, glory and the noor (radiance) of Your countenance that You bless me with the Holy Qur-aan so that it permeates my flesh, my blood, my hearing and my seeing. Grant me through Your power the ability that I may act upon it as I have no ability or strength except from You.

entries.title: O Allah, I am Your servant and the son of Your servant, the son of Your bondswoman.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I am Your servant and the son of Your servant, the son of Your bondswoman. I am always within Your grasp, my movements are under Your control, I testify to meeting You, I believe in Your promise. You commanded me but I disobeyed You. You prohibited me (from doing certain things) but I did not restrain myself. Here is a person who is begging You for safety from the Fire of Hell. There is no deity besides You. You are most pure. I have wronged my soul, please forgive me as You alone can forgive sins.

entries.title: O Allah, take care of me through Your eyes which never sleep, embrace me with Your strength from which no o...
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, take care of me through Your eyes which never sleep, embrace me with Your strength from which no one can be seperated and have mercy on me through Your power so that I may not be destroyed. (O Allah) You are my only hope. How many gifts have You showered upon me for which I was deficient in offering gratitude to You. Many were the occasions on which You tested me and I was found lacking in patience. O the One who did not deprive me of His Grace despite my ungratefulness, who did not disgrace me in spite of my impatience and who witnessed my sins but did not expose them. O the One who is full of everlasting goodness that never ends and O You who distributes favours that cannot be counted, I beg of You to shower Your blessings on Nabi Muhammad and his progeny. O Allah, with Your help do we repel our enemies and oppressors. O Allah, assist me in my Deen through this world, and in my hereafter through piety, look after my affairs which are hidden from me and do not leave me alone to deal with those affairs which are before me. O the One whom the sins of the creation cannot harm and who loses nothing by forgiving, favour me with that which does not cause You any loss (i.e., forgiveness) and forgive me from what does not cause You any harm (i.e. sins). Verily You are a Generous Giver. O Allah I beg of You for an instant solution in every calamity, remarkable patience, abundant sustenance and safety from all trials and I beg of You for perfect and lasting ease and the ability to be grateful for it and I beg of You for total independence from others. There is no ability or strength in us except with the help of Allah, Most High and most Great. O my Rabb, O my Rabb, O my Rabb.

entries.meaning: Verily, Allah Ta’ala and His angels send durood upon the Messenger ﷺ. O you who believe, send durood and salaams upon him. O Allah, my Rabb, I am present and (I am prepared to support Your Deen.) May the mercy of Allah, The Kind and Compassionate, be showered on our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ and similarly the greetings of His angels, His chosen ones, the Messengers, the very pious believers, the martyrs and the righteous people and all things which glorify Allah, be offered to our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ the son of Abdullah, the last Nabi and the head of all the Ambiyaa, the leader of the pious, the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds, who will be a witness (on the Day of Judgement). He is the giver of glad tidings, and he invites to You with Your permission and he spreads the light (like an illuminating lamp), so peace be upon him.

entries.title: O Allah bestow Your special mercy on him
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I beg of You with a request that is the best in Your sight, (I beg of You) through Your names which are dearest and most exalted to You, through Your greatest favour upon us, i.e. favouring us with Nabi Muhammad ﷺ and saving us through him from falling into misguidance. You commanded us to send salawaat upon him and made this practice a means of achieving great heights, an atonement for our sins and attaining Your kindness and mercy. I beg of You, honouring Your command, in compliance with Your order and in fulfilment of the duty which we owe to our Nabi ﷺ in an attempt to try and fulfil his rights which we owe to him. You have commanded Your servants that they offer salawaat upon him; an obligation which you have made compulsory on them I also beg of You by the Majesty of Your countenance and the light of Your Greatness that You, O Allah, along with Your angels send the best greetings and bestow the best mercy upon our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ, Your servant, prophet, messenger and the chosen one. Verily You are the Praiseworthy and the Glorious. O Allah, grant him a high rank, an honourable position, make his scales weighty, grant him his reward in abundance, strengthen his testimony, allow his religion to dominate and intensify his light, continue his excellence and nobility through his children and family who may become a source of coolness to his eyes and grant him O Allah, grant superiority to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad in as far as the number of his followers and supporters are concerned, in excellence, splendour and rank, grant him the most spacious abodes in paradise, the most amount of reward, the closest to You in Your presence, firmness in position, correctness in speech, success in having his duas answered, the most fortunate in Your Court, the most desirous for what is with You and (O Allah) grant him the highest abode in Jannah to live therein forever. O Allah, make our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ the most truthful in speech, most successful in his duas, the first to intercede (on the Day of Judgement), the most privileged amongst the intercessors and accept his intercession on behalf of his ummat to the extent which may be and (O Allah) when You give Your final verdict (on the Day of Judgement), assigning different positions to Your servants, then place our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ in the category of those who are the most truthful in expression, most virtuous in deeds and the best guided as far as treading the path is concerned. O Allah, make Nabi ﷺ our guide and make his pond (Haudh -e-Kausar) a place for quenching our thirst. O Allah, raise us (on the Day of Judgement) amongst his assembly, enable us to follow his Sunnah, cause us to die adhering to his religion and raise us from amongst his group. O Allah unite us with him as we have believed in him without having seen him and make it such that we may not be separated from him to the extent that we enter into Jannah with him and (O Allah) include us amongst his companions along with and the righteous. And What a blessed company that will be! O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who is the light of guidance, who leads people towards virtue, calls them to righteousness, The Nabi of Mercy, who soothes all grief, is the head of all the pious and the messenger of the Rabb of the worlds. (O Allah bestow Your special mercy on him) as he conveyed Your message, recited Your aayaat, advised Your servants, established Your law (limits), fulfilled his promises to You, carried out Your commandments, enjoined obedience to You, prohibited Your disobedience, befriend those whom You liked to be befriended, showed enmity towards Your enemy whom You were pleased that they be treated such. May Allah’s blessings be showered on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on his body among all other bodies, on his soul among all other souls, on his abode among all other abodes, on his position among all other positions and (O Allah) wherever there is mention of his name let it be supplemented by our durood to our Nabi ﷺ. O Allah, convey our salaams to him whenever there is mention of it and may peace and Allah’s blessings and mercy be upon Nabi ﷺ. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on Your chosen angels, on all the carriers of Your Throne, on Jibraeel (alayhis salaam) Mikaeel (alayhis salaam), Israfeel (alayhis salaam), the angel of death, Ridwaan (the angels guarding Jannah), Maalik (the angel guarding Jahannam), on Kiraaman Kaatibeen (the angels who record good and bad deeds) and (O Allah) send Your choicest blessings upon the family of our Nabi’s ﷺ household compared to the inmates of the households of all the other Messengers and the best reward to the companions of Your Nabi ﷺ as compared to all the companions of the other Messengers. O Allah, forgive me and all the believing men and women, all the Muslim men and women including those who are alive and those who have passed away and our Muslim brothers who lived before us, and (O Allah) do not leave any ill-feelings in our hearts towards the Muslims. Verily You are Most Kind and all Merciful.

entries.meaning: O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Muhammad ﷺ and raise him to the position of Waseelah and to the highest position in Jannah. O Allah, grant Your chosen ones his love and (grant) to those near to You, his friendship and manifest his name on the lips of the highest ranking personalities. O the One who does not need any support and is a support for everyone else, all hopes have been cut off except from You. Give me salvation from the situation in which I am and help me in the affliction that I find myself in, through Your benevolence and by virtue of the of Nabi Muhammad ﷺ on You. Aameen!

entries.title: Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatet.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatest, Allah is The Greatet. I invoke the blessings of Allah’s name upon my soul, my Deen, my family, my wealth and whatever my Rabb has gifted to me. I begin with the name of Allah which is the best of names, who is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth. I begin with the name of Allah by virtue of which no disease can harm me. I begin with the name of Allah and my reliance is totally upon Him. Allah, verily Allah is my Sustainer and I do not join any partners with Him. O Allah, I beg of You through Your goodness, which You alone bestow, respected is Your protection and lofty is Your praise, there is no deity besides You; to keep me in Your protection against all evils and the accursed shaytaan. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from everything that You have created and I seek Your protection from their evil. I place in front of me the following Surah of the Holy Qur-aan: In the name of Allah, Most Merciful, Most Gracious. Say: Allah is One. Allah is absolutely independent. He did not give birth to anyone neither did anyone give birth to Him and nor is anyone equal to Him.” In front of me, behind me, on my right and left, above me and beneath me.

entries.title: O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ among the first to come.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ among the first to come. Bestow Your special mercy on him among the last to come. Bestow Your special mercy on him amongst the prophets. Bestow Your special mercy on him amongst the Messengers and bestow Your special mercy on him, till the Day of Judgement, amongst the high ranking angels. O Allah, continue sending durood upon our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ until you are pleased and continue sending blessings upon him even after You are pleased and bless him forever and ever. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ as You have commanded us to offer salutations to him; send salutations upon him in the manner You would be pleased that durood is sent upon him. And send salutations upon Nabi Muhammad ﷺ as much as You desire to be sent upon him. O Allah, grant Your special mercy to our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ equal to the number of Your creation and to the extent of Your pleasure. Send salutations upon Nabi Muhammad ﷺ equal to the weight of Your Throne and send salutations equal to the ink used to write Your words which never end. O Allah, grant our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ the position of Waseela and grant him excellence and a very high rank. O Allah, honour his testimony to prophet-hood (with acceptance), strengthen his testimony and fulfil his wishes regarding his household and his followers. O Allah, shower Your blessings, mercy and kindness on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who is Your beloved and chosen one and shower your blessings on the members of his family who are completely purified and pure. O Allah, from all the grace and bounties You have bestowed upon anyone of Your creation, bestow Your best salawaat (salutation) on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. Bless him and have mercy upon him like that as well. O Allah, shower Your mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ during the night when its darkness covers all things and during the day when it brightens up everything and shower Your mercy upon him in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, bestow Your complete mercy, blessings and peace on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master Muhammad ﷺ who is a guide to goodness, the leader of virtue and a prophet of mercy. O Allah, shower Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ for ever and ever and for all times. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ the unlettered Arab prophet, who is Quraishi and Haashmi by descent, resident of the Holy City of Makkah, the possessor of the crown (leadership) and the stick (discipline), one who is blessed with jihad (striving in the path of Allah), spoils of war and the distributor of it. One who imparts virtue and other benefits, has armies under his command, is a generous giver, possess of miraculous signs and special symbols and is predestined to occupy the highest pedestal in the Hereafter. The one who is in charge of the Haudh-e-Kausar (Pond of water) which will be visited by all the (thirsty) people (on the Day of Judgement) and to intercede on behalf of all the creatures by performing sajdah before Allah Ta’ala the Praiseworthy. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ equal to the number of times people have offered their salaams to him as well as the number of those who have not sent salaams upon him.

entries.title: O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who, with his noor, turned darkness into light.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who, with his noor, turned darkness into light. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who was sent as a mercy for all the people of the worlds. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who had been chosen to be the most superior Nabi even before the pen and the plate were created. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who was the best in morals and habits. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who is unique with comprehensive speech and blessed with deep wisdom. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ in whose presence no one was ever insulted nor was the slightest form of injustice, done by anyone, overlooked. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who used to be shaded by a cloud whenever he would travel in any direction. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ for whom the moon was split into two pieces, stones talked to him and and supported it. O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who was praised by Allah Ta’ala Himself having been pleased with him since eternity. O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ who has been blessed by our Rabb in His Divine Book and we have been commanded therein to send salaat and salaam upon him. Hence we ask You, O Allah, to be pleased with him and to shower Your special mercy on him, his family, companions and wives for as long as the rains continue to pour and the sails of forgiveness are extended over the sinners and (O Allah) grant him peace, excellence and honour.

entries.meaning: O Allah, bestow Your special mercy on our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ whose noor (light) preceded the entire creation and whose arrival became a mercy unto all the worlds. Let Your special mercy be repeated as many times as the number of Your creatures, past, present and future, as well as the number of fortunate and doomed among them. Rather, a mercy which exceeds all mathematical figures and whose limits know no end. Such salawaat which is everlasting with Your eternal existence and (O Allah) favour the family and companions of our beloved Nabi ﷺ with the same amount of mercy. All praise is due to Allah for all of this.

entries.title: O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ and his family.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, bless our Noble Master, Nabi Muhammad ﷺ and his family. O Allah, bless us with halaal sustenance which is pure and blessed, such that it will save our respect from having to approach any one of Your creation for help. O Allah, make for us an easy path towards You which is not tiresome or painful and has no obligation for us towards others. O Allah, save us from haraam (unlawful) in whichever form, from whichever place or from any person. Please come in between us and those people who have such (haraam) means. Turn away their hands from us and divert their hearts from us, so that we become immune from such things and act only in accordance with Your pleasure. (O Allah) enable us to utilise Your gifts to do such actions which are pleasing to You, O The Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

entries.title: Our Rabb, You created and perfected all creation.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: Our Rabb, You created and perfected all creation. Our Rabb, You had destined (predetermined everything) and accordingly Your decree was fulfiled. You established Yourself on Your throne (in a manner that is befitting Your majesty). You give death and thereafter You give life again. You provide food and satisfy the appetite. You provide water and quench the thirst. You transport us with Your boats and animals across the land and sea. Enter me into the secrets of Your heavenly court, draw me in closeness to You and grant me an excellent abode. (O Allah) make me from those who fear standing before You, fear Your warnings and are desirous of meeting You. Make me from those who offer sincere repentance to You. And I beg of You to bless me with actions that are accepted by You, sound knowledge, an effort which earns Your appreciation and a trade which never suffers a loss.

entries.meaning: Allah is enough for me for my Deen. Allah is enough for me whenever I am worried Allah is enough for when I am victimised by anybody, Allah is enough for me when someone is jealous of me or when anybody plans to harm me. Allah is enough for me during the pangs of death. Allah is enough for me at the time of questioning in the grave. Allah is enough for me when my actions will be weighed on the scales on the Day of Qiyaamah. Allah is enough for me at the time when I have to pass over the Bridge. Allah is enough for me. There is no supreme being besides Him, on Him have I placed my trust and He is the Rabb of the Great Throne.

entries.title: O Allah, we beg You by the rights which beggars have over You and verily beggars do have rights over You.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, we beg You by the rights which beggars have over You and verily beggars do have rights over You. If You have accepted the duas of any one of Your slaves amongst the inhabitants of the land and the sea, then join us in the blessed duas they have made to You and let them also be joined with us in the good duas we make to You. Grant us peace and grant them peace as well. Accept from us and from them, overlook their faults and ours. Verily we believe in what You have revealed and we have obeyed Your messenger, so count us among those who testify.

entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I complain only to You to fulfil my needs of my weakness; that I do not have the resources and that I do not hold any significance in the eyes of people. O The Most Merciful of all those who show mercy, to whom are You going to entrust me? To an enemy who would look at me harshly at me or to a stranger whom You have given the control of my affairs. If You are not angry with me, then (O Allah) I do not care for anything except that I should enjoy Your protection. I seek protection in the Noor of Your Noble Countenance which brightens up the skies and which removes all kinds of darkness and controls the affairs of this world and the hereafter. May it never be that you become angry with me or your wrath descends upon me I must continue to please You until You are happy with me. There is no strength (to refrain from evil) nor any power (to do any good) except with Your help.

entries.title: You are absolutely pure and sublime, there is no deity besides You, forgive my sins and correct my actions.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: You are absolutely pure and sublime, there is no deity besides You, forgive my sins and correct my actions. Verily You forgive the sins of whomsoever You please and You are indeed Most Forgiving and Most Merciful. O the One who is most forgiving, forgive me. O the One who accepts repentance, accept my repentance. O the One who is full of mercy, have mercy on me. O the One who pardons sins, pardon me. O the One who is most kind, be kind to me. O Allah, grant me the ability to be grateful to You for Your favours, which You have bestowed upon me and grant me the ability to worship You in the best manner. O Allah! I beg of You all kinds of good. O Allah! Let me begin with good and make me breathe my last in a state of goodness, grant me a strong passion for meeting with You in a condition where there is no suffering or a test. (i.e. it should be a meeting of a blessed servant with his Supreme Creator) and save me from all types of evil. Surely The one whom You save from evils on that Day is truly blessed by You and it is indeed a great success.

entries.meaning: O Allah, I ask of you to grant me taufeeq (ability) like that of the people of guidance, actions like that of the people of yaqeen (conviction), sincerity like those who repent for their sins, courage like those who make sabr (patience), sacrifice like those who have fear, aspirations as posessed by those who are endowed with Your love, ibaadat (worship) like that of the pious and recognition like that of the Ulama. And allow all of these (blessings) to remain with me till I meet with You. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with such fear which would prevent me from committing sins so that I may do acts of obedience for You in a way that I will receive Your pleasure, and I may repent earnestly before You out of fear for You, that I may be encouraged to do acts of worship out of special regards for You, and I may rely purely on You in all matters and hope for the best from You, O The Unblemished Creator of light.

entries.title: O Allah, I beg Your forgiveness for sins which I have committed after having repented for them.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I beg Your forgiveness for sins which I have committed after having repented for them. I beg Your forgiveness for all the promises which I made to You but failed to fulfil them. I beg Your forgiveness for having used Your favours to commit sins against You. I beg Your forgiveness for all such actions which I intended to do purely for Your sake but thereafter mixed them with something which was not solely for Your pleasure. O Allah, do not disgrace me even though You know everything about me and do not punish me even though You have full power over me.

entries.title: O Allah, all praise is for You and You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, all praise is for You and You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. You are the Ruler of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. All praise is for You. You are the (noor) light of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them. All praise is for You. You are True, Your promise is true and our meeting You is a reality, Your word is true. Paradise is a reality. Hell is a reality and the Messenger of Allah, is true and the Hour (of Resurrection) is a reality. O Allah, I have submitted before You in obedience. I have believed in You and I have placed my trust in You. I have turned my attention solely towards You. Wherever I have quarrelled (in support of right and justice) it was with Your help. I have turned towards You for judgment. You are our Rabb and to You is our ultimate return. Forgive all my sins, past and future, whether done secretly or openly and those sins where I have surpassed the limit (in sinning) and You know more (what I have done) than I know. You are The First and The Last. There is no god besides You. There is no power to do good and no strength to refrain from evil except with the help of Allah.

entries.title: O Allah, You are the Creator, full of greatness.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, You are the Creator, full of greatness. You hear and know everything. You are Forgiving and Merciful and You are indeed the Rabb of the Great Throne. O Allah, You are extremely Compassionate, Generous and Kind. Please forgive me and have mercy on me. Grant me ease and sustenance, cover my faults, restore my losses, elevate me, guide me, do not let me go astray and admit me to Jannah through Your Mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

entries.title: O Allah, I seek Your protection from arrogance due to wealth and disgrace due to poverty.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: O Allah, I seek Your protection from arrogance due to wealth and disgrace due to poverty. O The One who fulfils His promises, Who warned of punishment but instead forgave us, please forgive the one who has committed injustice and acted wrongly. O The One to Whom my obedience brings pleasure and my sins cause Him no harm, grant me what is pleasing to You and forgive me, from that which causes You no harm.

entries.title: Oh Allah, the being who levelled the earth, creator of the high skies.
entries.arabic_omitted_note: Arabic omitted because PDF extraction was not reliable.
entries.meaning: Oh Allah, the being who levelled the earth, creator of the high skies. Oh Master of the hearts which have been moulded on their natural good or bad. Grant your honourable mercies Your fruitful blessing and most lavish kindness to Muhammad may the peace and blessings of Allah Ta’ala be upon him, your servant and messenger; the one who has (perfected) and sealed nubuwwat which continued before him, the opener of (avenues of spiritual perfection) which has been closed, the one who has announced true deen with honesty, the conqueror of the armies of falsehood. As he was entrusted with this responsibility, he got ready to obey you as per your command, enthusiastic to acquire You pleasure without hesitating and without the least dullness in resolve, the one who safeguarded your revelations. And fully observed the promises made to you, one who worked (tirelessly) to execute your commandments until he kindled the light for the one seeking light. The favours of Allah Ta’ala convey the seekers of light to the enlightened path. Through him ﷺ the hearts Were enabled to be guided after being submerged in trials and sins and through him ﷺ Allah Ta’ala exposed the clear signs. And the radiant light of Islam and its bright practices. So he is the trusted one on whom you have full confidence and the custodian of Your treasure of treasure of knowledge and Your witness on the day of Judgement, he is the one who you have blessed with nubuwwat out of Your sheer grace, the one who, You, out of your mercy has charged to be Your true messenger. Oh Allah Ta’ala widen for his spacious residence in your eternal paradise. and by Your grace reward him with multiplied virtues i.e. Your special abundant reward and Your immense treasure of gifts which will prove to be a source of happiness for him and not a source of displeasing him. Oh Allah Ta’ala, raise his palace above The buildings of all that build and honour his presence in Your court and afford him the best hospitality. And perfect for him his light. And honour him to rise in the plains of Hashr, With his testimony, earning Your approval, his speech conforming to Your pleasure, his word being just, his line of action being the decisive factor between right and wrong, his argument being triumphant and strong. May the peace and blessings of Allah Ta’ala be upon him.
